content_sections.heading: IOCL Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: Indian Oil Corporation Limited has invited applications for experienced professional positions. The post-wise details are given below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates having the required educational qualification and professional experience as per IOCL recruitment rules can apply for these posts. Production Manager: Candidates with relevant qualification and experience in the required field. Senior Production Manager: Candidates with relevant qualification and required professional experience. Senior Manager (PBR-Marketing): Candidates with relevant qualification and experience in PBR-Marketing related areas.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Production Manager: ₹80,000 - 2,20,000 Senior Production Manager: ₹90,000 - 2,40,000 Senior Manager (PBR-Marketing): ₹90,000 - 2,40,000

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official IOCL careers website. Open the latest job openings section. Read the official recruitment notification carefully. Click on the online application link. Complete the registration process. Fill out the application form with correct details. Upload required documents. Submit the application form before the last date. Take a printout of the application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of IOCL?
faq.answer: IOCL stands for Indian Oil Corporation Limited.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are available in IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Production Manager, Senior Production Manager and Senior Manager (PBR-Marketing) posts are available.

faq.question: Q3. When will the IOCL Recruitment 2026 application process start?
faq.answer: The online application portal is expected to open on 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 16 September 2026 (Tentative).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered in IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The pay scale ranges from ₹80,000 to ₹2,40,000 depending on the post.
